topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: The rain's been drumming on the window like it's trying to get in, and I've been staring at the same four walls for what feels like forever. Came a knock on the door. A neighbor I barely know, wanting to chat about the yard. Wants to start a garden, she says, needs a little extra space. I looked at her, saw the way she wouldn’t meet my eyes. This city's got too many secrets, and every smile’s got a reason. I told her I’d think about it, and watched her walk away, thinking about what kind of trouble a little patch of dirt could stir up. Rain’s still coming down, and I can’t shake the feeling that come morning, things won’t be the same.
